info.title: City Memory API
info.summary: Reference data for all 565 Belgian municipalities.
info.description:
A free, public, read-only API. Every endpoint is a static file on a CDN, so there are no keys, no quotas and no rate limits — but also no query parameters: filter the collections client-side, or fetch the province or region file you need.

Data is an OpenStreetMap extract of 2026-09-20T11:49:36Z, under ODbL. If you redistribute the data you must attribute OpenStreetMap contributors.

get.description: All 565 in one response, with names, codes, centroid, bbox and area but no boundary. About 250 kB. Fetch this once and filter it locally.

nis.description: The five-digit Belgian NIS/INS code. The stable key for a municipality.

name.description: The official name as the municipality itself writes it.

areaKm2.description: Surface area in square kilometres, from the spherical excess of the boundary.

parts.description: How many disjoint polygons the municipality is made of. Baarle-Hertog has 26.

neighbourCount.description: How many other Belgian municipalities share a border with this one.

wikidata.description: The Wikidata Q-id, if OSM records one.

get.description: A GeoJSON Feature: the summary fields under `properties`, and the boundary under `geometry` at roughly 10 m fidelity.
